text:
Perhaps I should
be a little grateful
to Jakini...
Working in the fields must be hard,
but they're getting
proper meals, at least.
So it's all right, isn't it?
What worries me more is
▲.
What worries me more is
▲.
There's been less conversation lately.
We hardly talk
except when it's necessary.
What could have happened?
I'm a little concerned...
Huh? Is that...?
Over there...
Is that...?
 Kyle?
 Sonolar?
Is that...?
 Kyle?
 Sonolar?
